index.meta.title: GGanbu Chat — Abantu beza, bagize ubumwe
index.meta.desc: App yo kuganira n'abantu bari hafi y'abakuru ifite ikinyabupfura. Menya abantu bakuriye hafi, tuvane mu ndimi zitandukanye, kandi wubake isano yizewe itari iy'imibonano mpuzamvuduko.

index.hero.badge: Guganira n'abari hafi mu buryo bw'ubucuti · Yakozwe hashingiwe ku guhitamo
index.hero.title:
Abantu beza,
bagize ubumwe.
index.hero.sub: GGanbu Chat ifasha abantu bakuru bari hafi gutangira ibiganiro by'icyubahiro, gusobanukirwana mu ndimi zitandukanye, no kubaka ubucuti nyakuri—binyuze kuri Bluetooth.
index.hero.note: Nta konti · Nta guhuza abantu mu buryo butunganyijwe · Uhitamo uwo wavugana na we
index.meaning.title: Inshuti yizerwa, si umubano w'imibonano mpuzabitsina.
index.meaning.lead: “GGanbu” bisobanura inshuti y'inda kandi yizerwa—umuntu wavugana na we mu buryo bugaragara kandi ukamuha kwitaho. Iyi app yateguwe kugira ngo haboneka itumanaho ryiza, ritari iry'imibonano mpuzabitsina, hagati y'abantu bakuru bacyubashijwe.
index.meaning.p1: Imibanire myiza ishingiye ku byo mwembi mukunda n'icyubahiro.
index.meaning.p2: Uburyo bworoshye bwo kugenzura uburyo ugaragara, kubuza, no gutanga raporo
index.meaning.p3: Nta guhuza abantu mu buryo bwa hapishapi cyangwa igihangayiko cyo gusubiza
index.features.eyebrow: Yateguwe kugira ngo ibiganiro bibe byiza kurushaho
index.features.title: Ikoranabuhanga ryoroshye. Isano y'abantu.
index.features.lead: GGanbu Chat ituma itumanaho ry'ahamenyerere rirushaho kuba ryo mu buryo butaziguye, kandi ikaguha ibikoresho byiza byo guhuza abantu mu buryo bufashwe n'intego.
index.feat.1.d: Bluetooth Low Energy ifasha ibikoresho biri hafi kumenyana no guhuza mu buryo butaziguye. Ibiganiro by'ingenzi ntibinyura muri seriveri isanzwe y'ibiganiro.
index.feat.2.d: Koresha endpoint ihuje na Ollama yateguwe kugira ngo urebe ubutumwa bw'umwimerere n'ubuhinduye icyo gihe, bitume ibiganiro biba byoroshye.
index.feat.3.d: iOS na Android zikoresha itumanaho rimwe ryo hafi, bityo abantu bari hafi yawe ntibagabanywa n'uburyo bahisemo telefone.
index.feat.4.d: Iyo mwemeye ubucuti, muba GGanbu—inshuti zizerana zihisemo gukomeza kuba zifashanye.
index.feat.5.d: Ohereza amafoto ndetse n'inyandiko mu buryo butaziguye ukoresheje Bluetooth, kandi ugabanze ibyabaye mu buzima bwa buri munsi n'abantu wizera.
index.feat.6.d: Hitamo igihe ushobora kugaragara, siba ibiganiro byo hano, kandi uzire cyangwa utegeke abakoresha bishyira mu kaga. GGanbu Chat ni itumanaho ry'abageze mu myaka 18 cyangwa irenga.
index.how.title: Uguma ufite ububasha kuva mu ntangiriro.
index.how.lead: Shyiraho profile, hitamo igihe wifuza kugaragara, kandi uhitemo uwo ushaka kuvugana.
index.step.1.d: Kora profile, uhaye uburenganzira bugendana n'ibiganiro by'abantu bari hafi, kandi uhitemo igihe wifuza kugaragara.
index.step.2.d: Abantu bakuru bashobora gushakashwa bari mu kape imwe, mu bubiko bw'ibitabo, mu bikorwa, cyangwa ahantu hasanganywe, bagaragara hashingiwe ku kwegerana kwa Bluetooth.
index.step.3.d: Hitamo profile iri hafi hanyuma utangire ikiganiro cyo mu buryo butaziguye. Guhindura ururimi (bishobora gukorwa) bishobora gufasha abantu bombi kumva ko basobanukiwe.
index.lang.title: Naho habaye harimo indimi zitandukanye, abantu bashobora kumva ko bari hafi.
index.lang.lead: Iyo endpoint y'ihindura ururimi ikunze gukoreshwa yashyizweho, GGanbu Chat ishobora gufasha guhindura ibiganiro ariko ikomeza kugaragaza ubutumwa bw'umwimerere.
index.dl.title: GGanbu yawe ukurikira ashobora kuba ari hafi.
index.dl.lead: Manura GGanbu Chat kuri iOS cyangwa Android hanyuma uhure n'abantu bari hafi mu buryo bw'icyubahiro kandi bufite intego. Ni ku bantu bageze mu myaka 18+.

privacy.meta.title: Amategeko agenga ibanga — GGanbu Chat
privacy.meta.desc: Amategeko agenga ibanga ya GGanbu Chat
privacy.title: Politiki y'ibanga
privacy.updated: Yahindutse bwa nyuma: Ku wa 18 Nyakanga 2026
privacy.intro: GGanbu Chat ("app," "twebwe," cyangwa "iyacu") ni app yo gushyikirana n'abantu bari hafi itanzwe n'umutangawutunga (developer) ugaragara mu rutonde rwa app-store. Ibiganiro by'ingenzi bishyirwanaho mu buryo butajije hagati y'ibikoresho binyuze muri Bluetooth aho kunyura kuri serivisi y'ibiganiro (chat server) isanzwe. Zimwe mu mirimo ihitamo, harimo guhindura ururimi, raporo z'umutekano, no kugura ibintu muri app, bikoresha serivisi za network cyangwa platform nk'uko bisobanuwe hanoze. Iyi Politiki y'ibanga isobanura amakuru akoreshwa, impamvu akoreshwa, uwo ashobora gusangizwa, igihe agumana na twe, n'amahitamo ufite.
privacy.s1.p: Bitewe n'imikorere uhisemo, app ikoresha ibi byiciro by'amakuru bikurikira:
privacy.s1.l1: Amakuru y'umwirondoro n'ayo guhurira — izina ryawe ryerekana, kandi niba uhisemo kubitanga, ifoto y'umwirondoro n'imeyili (email). Umwirondoro wawe ugaragara ku basanzwe bari hafi igihe ushobora kugaragarira. Imeyili yawe ishobora gusangizwa undi mukoresha gusa nyuma yo kuba mufite inyungu ya GGanbu mutunganye, kandi ishobora kugaragara muri raporo y'umutekano uhisemo kohereza.
privacy.s1.l2: Ibyashyizweho n'umukoresha — ubutumwa n'amafoto mushyirwanaho bika bikorerwa mu bikoresho bikoreshwa kandi byoherezwa mu buryo butajije binyuze muri Bluetooth. Niba wohereza raporo y'umutekano, iyo raporo ishobora gukubiyemo ubutumwa bwakozweho, imiterere y'ibiganiro bya hafi, n'amafoto wakiriye ku mukoresha wakozeho raporo.
privacy.s1.l3: Amakuru y'ikoresho n'aho giherereye — imyirondoro ya app (app identifier) ikozwe mu buryo buteganyijwe itandukanya abakoresha bari hafi. Imbaraga za Bluetooth (RSSI) zikoreshwa mu kumenya niba hari hafi. App ntikoreshe RSSI kugira ngo ibone cyangwa ibike imiterere ya GPS (GPS coordinates).
privacy.s1.l4: Amakuru y'iraporo, app, no kugura — raporo ishobora gukubiyemo amazina y'uwakoze raporo n'uwakozeho, imeyili y'uwakoze raporo, impamvu n'igihe raporo yakozwe, verisiyo ya app, n'igice cy'imyirondoro ya app (app identifier) y'uwakozeho raporo yashyizwe mu buryo bw'ibanga (encrypted). Apple cyangwa Google bashobora gutanga amakuru y'uko kugura bimeze n'imyirondoro y'imikoranire (transaction identifiers) ikenewe kugira ngo imikorere yo kugura muri app irangize cyangwa isubizwe.
privacy.s2.p: Tukoresha amakuru gusa kugira ngo dutange uburyo bwo kumenya ibikoresho biri hafi no itumanaho ryo ku gikoresho ku cyindi, tukore ubuhinduzi busabwa, tuzuze igurana, tubuze ikoreshwa nabi, tusubize raporo n'ibisabwa mu bufasha, kandi tugende nk'amategeko. Amakuru y'umwirondoro (profile) n'ibiganiro bisangirwa n'abakoresha bari hafi watoranyije kugendana na bo. Inyandiko zihinduwe zisangirwa n'itumanaho ry'ubuhinduzi (translation endpoint) wateguye; amakuru y'igurana akorwaho na Apple cyangwa Google; kandi raporo zoherezwa binyuze mu kuregereza imeyili watoranyije zijya ku muntu wishinzwe umutekano. Iyo hitamo uha serivisi yo gukora amakuru, tusaba ko habaho uburyo bwo kurinda ibanga bujyanye n'iyi politiki; serivisi watoranyije ubwishobokirwe zifashishwa n'amasezerano yazo n'uburyo bwo kurinda ibanga. Ntitugurisha amakuru bwite, ntukoreshe mu kwamamaza kwa abandi, kandi ntukoreshe SDK zo kwamamaza cyangwa zo gukurikirana apps (cross-app tracking). Ntitwakira kopi za buri munsi z'ibiganiro byihariye kuri serivuri y'ibiganiro isanzwe.
privacy.s3.t: 3. Uburenganzira n'Uburyo bwo Kugenzura uko ugaragara
privacy.s3.l1: Bluetooth / Ibikoresho biri hafi — bikoreshwa mu gushaka, kumenyekanisha, guhuza, no gusangira ibintu n'ibikoresho biri hafi. Ibi burenganzira ni ingenze ku mirimo y'ingenzi y'app kandi bishobora gukurwa mu migenzo ya sisitemu.
privacy.s3.l2: Aho uri (Android 11 n'izindi za mbere) — verisiyo za Android za kera zisaba uburenganzira bwo kumenya aho uri kugira ngo Bluetooth ishakishe. Ku verisiyo nshya zishimangirwa, app isaba uburenganzira bw'Ibikoresho biri hafi kandi ikamenyesha ko gushakisha kuri Bluetooth bitakoreshwa mu kumenya aho uri mu buryo bugaragara. Ntitukusanya cyangwa ntutohereza imiterere ya GPS.
privacy.s3.l3: Amafoto n'amenyeshbyo — app ifungura gusa amafoto watoranyije ku mwirondoro (profile) cyangwa mu biganiro. Uburenganzira bw'amenyeshbyo bukoreshwa kugira ngo ukumenyeshwe ubutumwa no gufasha Bluetooth gukora aho sisitemu ibisaba. Ushobora kwanga cyangwa gukuraho uburenganzira butari bwo bwose mu migenzo ya sisitemu.
privacy.s3.l4: Kugaragara (Discoverability) — wowe uhitamo igihe ushaka ko umwirondoro wawe ugaragara ku bakoresha bari hafi. Iyo byashyizwe mu bikorwa, app imenyekanisha amakuru y'umwirondoro akenerwa kugira ngo ufatwe kuri Bluetooth. Ushobora guhagarika kugaragara igihe cyose ukoresheje imigendekere y'antena (antenna control). App ntigushyire kuri karita cyangwa ngo iguhuze mu biganiro mu buryo buteganyijwe.
privacy.s4.p: Ubuhinduzi ni amahitamo kandi busaba kugeza kuri endpoint ihuye na Ollama yateguwe muri app. Iyo usabye ubuhinduzi, inyandiko y'ubutumwa, amabwiriza y'ubuhinduzi, ururimi rwihindurirwamo, n'isabisho rya model byoherezwa kuri iyo endpoint binyuze mu network yo hafi cyangwa internet, bitewe n'ishuri (address) wateguye. Ushinzwe iyo endpoint ashobora na we kwakira amakuru asanzwe ya network nk'ishuri rya IP (IP address) kandi ni we wishimira umutekano, kwandika ibyabaye (logging), kubika, n'uburyo bwo kurinda ibanga. Ntitugenzura endpoint zatoranyijwe n'umukoresha. Ibiganiro bya Bluetooth bishobora gukomeza nta buhinduzi iyo endpoint itari ihari.
privacy.s5.p: Imwirondoro, ibiganiro, ababuzwe kuvugana, n'ishuri ryagenewe na app (app-generated identifier) bisanzwe bikorerwa kuri gikoresho cyawe igihe app cyangwa inyandiko zayo zikiri hari. Umutekano w'ibikoresho wa sisitemu urinda amakuru ya app ari hano (local). Umutekano wo kohereza amakuru kuri Bluetooth na network nawo uterwa n'ibikoresho bikoreshwa, endpoint yateguwe, network, n'uha serivisi z'imeyili. Nta buryo bwo kubika cyangwa kohereza amakuru burinda mu buryo budashobora kwangirika.
privacy.s5.l1: Siba ikiganiro — bikuraho icyo kiganiro kuri gikoresho cyawe. Ntibisibe kopi zageze ku wundi mukoresha, zabikwa, cyangwa zamenyekanijwe.
privacy.s5.l2: Kubuzanya umukoresha — bibika ibibuzanye kuri igikoresho cyawe kandi bikavunira ko profile ye yakomeza kugaragara cyangwa ko uhabwa ubutumwa buva kuri uwo muntu. Ushobora gucunga abakoresha wabuzanyije muri app.
privacy.s5.l3: Kohereza raporo — mbere na mbere ibuzanya umukoresha washize mu raporo, hanyuma hifungurwa ubutumwa bwa email bwiteguye kugira ngo uburebe. Iyo ubwohereje, raporo n'ibimenyero byose byatoranyijwe byoherezwa na ba nyakuri ba email yawe kuri bashinzwe umutekano bacu. Identiye y'app yashize mu raporo iba yifunzwe (encrypted) ku muremyi w'app, mu gihe ubutumwa bwa email n'amafoto bikurikiza amategeko y'uburyo ba nyakuri ba email yawe barinda amakuru. Tubika raporo gusa mu buryo bw'ingenzi kugira ngo tugire isuzuma, dukurikize amategeko yacu, turinde abakoresha, tukemura amakimbirane, kandi tunyuze mu mategeko, nyuma yaho zifashwa cyangwa zigahindurwa kugira ngo itandukane n'umuntu.
privacy.s5.l4: Gukuramo app cyangwa gusaba gusiba — gukuramo app bisanzwe bisiba amakuru y'app kuri igikoresho cyawe, bitewe n'uburyo itumanaho (operating-system) ryibika amakuru cyangwa kopi zishobora kuba ziri kuri ba nyakuri b'izindi services. Kubera ko nta konti ya app ibaho, nta konti yo kuri server ishobora gusibwa. Kugira ngo usabe gusiba raporo cyangwa inyandiko zo gufasha dutwara, tudukirire hanoze; dushobora kubika amakuru aho amategeko abiteganya cyangwa byaba ari ngombwa ku mutekano no kurwanya ubujura.
privacy.s6.p: Kugura muri app bikorwa na Apple App Store cyangwa Google Play hashingiwe ku masezerano n'amabwiriza y'ibanga by'urwo rubuga. Ntituzobona cyangwa ntubike numero yawe yose ya karite cyangwa ibindi bimenyetso byo kwishyura. App n'iduka (store) bashobora gusimbanura amakuru yerekeye ibyaguzwe, imikorere yo kwishyura, imiterere y'igikoresho/konti kugira ngo bashobore gukemura, kwemeza, cyangwa gusubiza ibyaguzwe.
privacy.s7.p: Iyi app igenewe abantu bakize bageze mu myaka 18 cyangwa irenga. Ntabwo igenewe abana, kandi uwo wese utageze mu myaka 18 ntashobora kuyikoresha. Niba utekereza ko umwana yatanze amakuru binyuze mu raporo cyangwa gusaba gufashwa, tudukirire kugira ngo tubisuzume kandi tuyisibe aho byaba bikwiye.
privacy.s8.p: Ushobora kureba cyangwa guhindura profile yawe, guhagarika ko abandi bakubona, gukuraho uburenganzira wahawe, gucunga abakoresha wabuzanyije, gusiba ibiganiro, guhagarika gukoresha uburyo bwo guhindura indimi (translation endpoint), cyangwa gukuramo app. Bitewe n'aho utuye, ushobora kandi kugira uburenganzira bwo kureba, gukosora, gusiba, kugabanya, kwemerera, cyangwa kubona kopi y'amakuru yawe bwite dutwara, no gukuraho uruhusha rwawe utabangamiye ibyakozwe mbere. Tudukirire kugira ngo ukoreshe uburenganzira bwawe. Ushobora kandi gutanga ikirego kuri ba nyakuri bashinzwe kurinda amakuru mu gace utuyemo. Dushobora kuba tugomba kwemeza ufashe mbere yo kubikora.
privacy.s9.p: Tushobora guhindura iyi politiki iyo app, uburyo dukora, cyangwa amategeko ahindutse. Tuzashyira hano politiki yahindutse kandi tuzahindure itariki iri hejuru. Niba ihinduka ryigize ingaruka zikomeye ku buryo dukoresha amakuru, tuzatanga indi notifications cyangwa uruhusha rwasabwa n'amategeko.
privacy.s10.p: Ku bibazo bijyanye n'iyi Politiki yo kurengera amakuru y'ibanga, nyamuneka tudukoreshe kuri:
